purpose: Compose an exact FreshGenesis transition with at most two versioned checkpoint-anchored transitions without reinterpreting the existing FreshGenesis-only carrier.

imports.import_rule: Each embedded raw step is independently strict-decoded and byte-for-byte re-encoded by its declared variant; JSON summaries are never authority.

handoff_sidecar_root_contract.root_rule: exact single-item typed ordered root; the complete wrapper and both signature lists are committed

TrustPathStepV1: Bytes; independently exact-decoded according to variant

verified_relations: The initial state is epoch-0 FreshGenesis, with identical finalized and certified heads and no checkpoint or handoff sidecar.
If present, step zero is exactly one existing FreshGenesis-only BoundedEpochTransitionEvidenceV1 raw CEV1 value.
ExistingFreshGenesisTransition is forbidden after position zero; CheckpointAnchoredTransition is forbidden at position zero.
Every later step input_state_id equals the exact prior canonical TrustedOrderStateV1 state_id.
Every checkpoint chain directly extends the prior certified head and consumes its certified_head_qc_id as the first justify_qc_id.
Checkpoint, seal, descriptor, validator set, parameters, dual weighted quorum handoff, activation block and three-chain finality are all independently recomputed.

Every V1HandoffFirst header commits exactly one complete EpochHandoffV1 ProtocolObjectSidecarV1 wrapper, including both role signature lists, through the recomputed root-kind-1 protocol_objects_root; its other ordered roots are empty.

A V1HandoffFirst at initial_new_view carries no TC; the bounded alternative skips exactly that initial view, carries one complete TimeoutCertificateV1 whose sole safe-parent object is the identical EpochHandoffV1, has no locked QC, names the exact latest finalized EpochCheckpointV1, and targets initial_new_view+1.
Each output state is derived from verified raw headers and certificates; carried output summaries cannot substitute intermediate state.
Epoch and finalized height increase strictly on every transition.
The successor checkpoint schedule is locally decidable and starts exactly after the certified head.
The path is bounded to at most three transitions and is canonical under replay and append.

resource_bounds.per_step_bytes: bounded by both old and new committed max_cev1_value_bytes
resource_bounds.certificate_signers: bounded by each epoch's committed max_certificate_signers

explicit_exclusions: No v0 activation authority or migration verification.
No weak-subjectivity checkpoint selection or trust expiry.
No arbitrary-length or unbounded trust path.

No ordinary-QC skipped-view transition inside CheckpointAnchoredTransitionStepV1, more than one skipped epoch-start view, multiple TCs in one step, Genesis/Activation epoch-start TC anchor, or general pacemaker-history verification.
No state-sync, DA, ApplicationStateProof, ArtifactAvailabilityProof or ResultSettlementFinalityProof verification.
No complete wire or crypto corpus claim.
No second implementation or interoperability claim.
No global light-client completeness, normative freeze, implementation or production activation claim.
